Main question: How do computers communicate over a network?

---
 Let's start with the question - What is a computer network? 
# What is a computer network?
> A computer network is a communications medium. That's all. Nothing more. A "computer" can be digital, analog, or organic in the form of people which is where the term "computer" was first applied, that is to "one who calculates". In that sense a "computer network" can be verbal, nonverbal, analog, digital... etc, etc.
> - b4xt3r from [a reddit post](https://www.reddit.com/r/InformationTechnology/comments/efqch1/serious_question_what_exactly_is_a_computer/)

I like this particular idea of a computer network because it's more generally accurate.

So the basic idea of a computer network is that it's a communication medium that allows two or more computers to exchange data.

Now let's say you wish to send a meme to your friend and a work-related report to your colleague form your computer, how do you/your computer know which computer belongs to your friend and should be sent the meme and which computer belongs to your colleague and should be sent the report? How does a computer know what, where, or who the other computer is? 

- How does a computer know exactly which computer to send the data to?

From what I know, IP address is used to uniquely identify devices over a network.


# IP Address
IP stands for Internet Protocol.

>An Internet Protocol address (IP address) is a numerical label, such as 192.168.1.1 or 2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334, that is assigned to a device connected to a computer network that uses the Internet Protocol for communication.
> - [Wikipedia - IP Address](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_address)

- What is the Internet Protocol?
- Who assigns the IP address to a device?

## Internet Protocol

> The Internet Protocol (IP) is a protocol, or set of rules, for routing and addressing packets of data so that they can travel across networks and arrive at the correct destination. Data traversing the Internet is divided into smaller pieces, called packets. IP information is attached to each packet, and this information helps routers to send packets to the right place. Every device or domain that connects to the Internet is assigned an IP address, and as packets are directed to the IP address attached to them, data arrives where it is needed.
> - [Cloudflare - What is the Internet Protocol?](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/network-layer/internet-protocol/)

muscle-protein-metabolism-mpm.title: Muscle Protein Metabolism (MPM)
muscle-protein-metabolism-mpm.content:
Muscle protein synthesis (MPS) is the metabolic process where the body builds and/or repairs skeletal muscle proteins.
Muscle protein breakdown (MPB) is the opposite. It's the metabolic process of breaking down the muscle proteins.

##### Protein Turnover
The body is in a constant state of protein synthesis and protein degradation which is known as protein turnover. A continuous process of replacing the broken proteins by synthesising proteins.

Net balance = Protein synthesis - Protein breakdown

Muscle growth occurs when the net balance is positive i.e. MPS > MPB.

%%What causes muscle protein breakdown?%%

# Muscle Protein Synthesis
%%What causes muscle protein synthesis?%%
- resistance exercise and dietary protein intake
- **Resistance Exercise (Mechanical Tension):** Lifting heavy weights or training to failure creates mechanical stress and micro-tears in muscle fibers. This stimulates MPS for up to 24 to 48 hours post-workout.
- **Essential Amino Acids (EAAs) & Leucine:** Consuming protein provides the building blocks (amino acids) needed to construct new muscle. The specific amino acid **leucine** acts as a primary trigger that turns on the **mTORC1** pathway, instructing ribosomes to build new muscle proteins.
- Insulin: Released in response to meals, insulin helps suppress muscle protein breakdown (MPB), shifting the body into a positive net protein balance. 
- Adequate Recovery & Sleep: Deep sleep supports hormonal balance and optimal myofibrillar protein synthesis, whereas sleep deprivation impairs muscle recovery.
